bounds.primary_source: Tejasvi Singh Tomar, The rank of 3x3 matrix multiplication over F2 is 23, arXiv:2610.11823v3, Introduction, 19 October 2026.
bounds.source_statement: The paper states that over fields of characteristic zero rank remains unknown and lies between 19 and 23. Its rank-23 optimality theorem is over F2; the integer-coefficient corollary does not settle arbitrary rational coefficients.
